result.description:
Full Time, in Artarmon, New South Wales
Vacancy Listing Dates 2/07/2026 to 30/07/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17401
- Seeking an Organisation and Methods (Quality Classing) Analyst
- Salary $80,000 + superannuation
- Join Australian Food and Fibre

Australian Food & Fibre (AFF) is a modern, integrated business that combines significant knowledge and expertise to supply quality Australian cotton to the world, as well as cereals, pulses and oil seeds.

We have a career opportunity for a skilled Organisation & Methods (Quality Classing) Analyst to join our team in our Artarmon laboratory, 2064, New South Wales.

Overall Responsibilities:

At the Australian Food & Fibre, Artarmon, facility you are responsible for testing, evaluating and grading our agricultural commodities. They ensure that raw materials (primarily cotton) meet strict domestic and international quality standards before they are exported or sold.

Daily tasks:
- Fibre testing - operating specialised laboratory instruments to analyse the physical properties of cotton samples. This includes measuring fibre length, strength, micronaire (fineness), maturity, and colour.
- Assess current systems - analyse and evaluate capabilities, and workflows to identify bottlenecks and process gaps.
- Commodity grading - applying standardised classing rules to assign grades to cotton lint. This determines the market value and spinning utility of the crop.
- Sample management - preparing, tracking, and cataloguing physical samples sent from various AFF farming and ginning operations (such as their sites in Moree and Narrabri).
- Data Analysis - recording and verifying data within classing and laboratory software systems, ensuring that every batch meets the requirements of export contracts.
- Quality assurance - monitoring laboratory equipment calibration to ensure accurate and reliable test results.
- Classing and compliance - develop, maintain and enforce Quality Auditor standards, reviewing operating procedures and advising on any departures from established guidelines.

Our ideal candidate will have:
- Hands-on trade experience through on-the-job training OR Certificate III in Cotton Ginning OR specialised industry-recognised classing grader advantageous OR an IT background will better equip you with the analytical skills required in our laboratory and for this role.
- Minimum 2+ years of experience in procedural/business/computer analysis, continuous improvement or quality control
- A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, IT, Commerce, Operations Management or a related field will be highly regarded.

While a formal agricultural degree can be advantageous for career advancement with us, our hands-on approach for you to function well in the role is to assist you in gaining certification from Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry as part of your induction with us and a requirement for our quality control and cotton exporting criteria.

In return, we can offer:
- Highly competitive salary package ($80,000 + super)
- Excellent professional development and career progression opportunities.
- Supportive, dynamic team environment with hybrid working arrangements.
- Opportunities for ongoing employment and training across seasonal operations.
- Contribution to the local agricultural economy in our regional NSW operations.

Join our company and enjoy a supportive, family-friendly environment where you'll receive in-house assistance and continuous opportunities for up-skilling, ensuring your ongoing professional growth.

APPLY NOW through our online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17401.php

We have an exciting opportunity for an IT Operations Engineer to join our National Operations Centre (NOC) team. We are seeking candidates with a strong background in IT systems and networks, coupled with extensive experience in managing IT service desk operations, and providing high-level support to internal and external staff. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in collaborating with various IT teams, ensuring the delivery of high-quality services to the business, while striving for operational excellence.

Please note this will be a permanent, full-time role based out of our Sydney CBD Office. It will involve participation in a continuous shift roster - working 4 days on and 4 days off. The shift patterns will be made up of 2-day shifts from 7am-7pm and 2-night shifts from 7pm-7am. 

Some of your responsibilities will include and are not limited to
•	Monitoring critical business services and systems, networks and infrastructure
•	Provide after-hours service desk support to users
•	Identify and address issues before they affect business operations
•	Handle and administer privileged accounts securely

What you’ll have done
•	Seasoned service desk analyst, NOC or equivalent experience (minimum 2 years), ideally in a continuous shift operations centre (24/7x365)
•	Strong technical knowledge of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, SNMP, DNS, DHCP, and other networking protocols
•	Strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues quickly, including experience with major incidents
•	Familiarity with server operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and basic server administration
•	Experience with technology service monitoring tools - systems, application, and networks such as Centreon, Solarwinds, PTRG desirable
•	Familiarity with IT service management tools and frameworks (ITIL v3/4)
•	Demonstrated experience in delivering exemplary support, customer service and training
•	Excellent documentation skills for keeping records of issues, resolutions, and operational procedures
•	Effective communication with the ability to work as part of a team, especially in a high-pressure environment where collaboration is essential to solving issues

What we can offer you
•	5 weeks annual leave 
•	Annual salary between 90,000 - 95,000
•	Opportunities to progress within I-MED’s continued growth and expansion 
•	Being part of a team that makes a difference to the functioning of our ever-growing business 
•	Experience in communicating with different areas of IT 
•	Enjoy exclusive benefits including discounted private health insurance, salary packaging, Fitness Passport access, lifestyle and travel discounts, I-MED services for your family and employee wellbeing support.

About Us
At I-MED, we're more than just a medical imaging provider - we're a community of passionate professionals committed to excellence for our patients. With over 200 clinics and a staggering 6 million patient procedures annually, we proudly stand as one of the largest providers of medical imaging in the world. Our success lies in our people with over 350 dedicated doctors and 4,000 staff members who actively share clinical knowledge and expertise. 

If you're looking for the next step in your career and are passionate about the delivery of excellence within healthcare services, apply today!
